summary: Successfully implemented ReadOnlyView support for MeteredWindowStore (KAFKA-20497). Added readOnly(IsolationLevel) method that returns a metered read-only view applying serdes conversion and recording fetch metrics. The ReadOnlyView inner class implements all ReadOnlyWindowStore methods, properly delegating to the wrapped store while maintaining metric collection and serde transformations. All 40 tests in MeteredWindowStoreTest pass, including 16 new tests for readOnly functionality.
